hook: Blend TVL stands at $159,033,033 while Soroswap TVL is $1,239,028. Seizing collateral without proportional onchain swap depth creates bad debt during market stress.
body: The failure mode begins at the swap pool. When liquidators attempt to clear seized collateral against $1,239,028 in decentralized exchange liquidity, slippage increases and underwater loans fail to settle. This contagion cannot spread through a credit network when lending caps are structurally bound to observable exchange reserves rather than total deposits. Insolvency remains localized wherever position sizes are not permitted to exceed verifiable liquidation capacity.
